mapper.select: /* AppReq09Mapper.selectUserNodeSelfApproveYn */ SELECT N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN FROM TB_USER U JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = U.NODE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND N.SELF_ATTD_APPRV_YN = 'Y' AND (N.MAIN_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD OR N.SUB_ADMIN_CD = U.USER_CD) LIMIT 1
